title: Dimi bar Kakuzta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 156a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.156a.8), Rav Ashi said: “Dimi bar Kakuzta and I were born on a Sunday”—Hyman explains, “we were born on the same day”—“I became a leader [literally, a king], while he became the chief of thieves.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Shabbat has Rav Ashi say that he and Dimi were born on a Sunday. “We were born on the same day” is Hyman’s explanatory parenthesis.
The story makes Rav Ashi a “king” and Dimi a chief of thieves. In this usage “king” means a leader.
